pages.text: A product born from the $(l:goetymech_machines/breeding_nest)Breeding Nest$(/l) — twisted flesh fused with dark magic.$(br)With negligible soul cost, it can be transformed into loyal new Illager servants; if soul energy is insufficient, it can be forcibly converted at half health.$(br)Alternatively, place it into the $(l:goetymech_machines/flesh_furnace)Flesh Furnace$(/l) to convert it into a more powerful warrior.$(br)But note: servants converted from Twisted Embryos cannot learn magic.$(br)$(4)"We have taken the first step — the foundation of the legion is established."$()
